integrity: Finite checks corroborate the local identities and small cases; infinite quantifiers are supported by an explicit symbolic reduction. No external or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies symmetric, context-closed duplication/deduplication congruence, not intersection of forward descendant cones; the eight-code construction is a lower bound, not optimality. No extensions to other duplication lengths or nonbinary alphabets. Priority remains subject to discovery of equivalent prior formulations.
title: The nineteen-element quotient of binary words under length-two palindromic duplication
